The wait between the first two seasons of "Severance" has already been long enough, and the third season is testing viewers' patience just as much — but Apple TV has just dropped a major update on the show's progress.

"Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming and is expected to premiere by the end of 2027

More than 18 months have passed since "Severance" Season 2 first aired. Although the progress of Season 3 may not be as fast as everyone hoped, it has just reached a major milestone.

According to a post by Ben Stiller on X and reposted by Apple TV's official account, "Severance" Season 3 has officially started filming.

Stiller's low-resolution production photo appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running through a Lumon corridor, echoing the iconic scene from the Season 2 finale.

The Season 2 finale saw Mark make a shocking decision to stay with Helly, defying his outie's original plan to reunite with Gemma, and paving the way for a string of gripping storylines in Season 3.

The gap between Season 1 and Season 2 of "Severance" was three years, owing to a host of factors including script rewrites, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If Season 3 takes 6 to 9 months to produce, plus another six months of post-production work, "Severance" will most likely return in the fall of 2027 — roughly three years after the previous season.

When do you expect "Severance" Season 3 to premiere? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
